title: VerificationCheckService
responsibility: Checks record identity, source integrity, lineage and current video reviewer obligations.

inputs.name: VerificationCheckService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to resolve commit and verification-store data for the service. It matters to every check because Git history, stored record lookup, and evidence paths are read relative to it.

inputs.name: VerificationCheckService.constructor.indexer
inputs.description: SourceIndexService passed to loadSide while rebuilding the committed source. Defaults to new SourceIndexService(): an instance may be shared and reuses parsing only for files with identical content, while each commit is still indexed and compared in full.

inputs.name: VerificationCheckService.check.commit
inputs.description: Git commit reference against which the stored record is checked. When record.source.commit matches it, the service resolves the commit tree and indexes its files; an unresolved revision can reject the operation.

inputs.name: VerificationCheckService.check.stored
inputs.description: Stored record envelope consumed by the check, including its record and storage directory. The record supplies outcome, components, lineage, and evidence metadata; evidence paths are resolved under the stored directory.

inputs.name: VerificationCheckService.integrity.commit
inputs.description: Git commit reference against which the stored record is checked. When record.source.commit matches it, the service resolves the commit tree and indexes its files; an unresolved revision can reject the operation.

inputs.name: VerificationCheckService.integrity.stored
inputs.description: Stored record envelope consumed by the check, including its record and storage directory. The record supplies outcome, components, lineage, and evidence metadata; evidence paths are resolved under the stored directory.

inputs.name: videoFlagProofFailures.root
inputs.description: Original repository with durable Git evidence; clean source exports must not be used as evidence roots.

inputs.name: videoFlagProofFailures.record
inputs.description: Sealed verification record whose present clip slots are checked against current reviewer standing.

outputs.name: VerificationCheckService.check
outputs.description: Promise resolves to a CheckReport with passed or failed status, the commit and record IDs, and problem strings. Integrity problems are included first; lineage problems are checked only when integrity is clean, while recorded failure messages are included whenever the record status is not passed.

outputs.name: VerificationCheckService.integrity
outputs.description: Promise resolves to problem strings for the record's source identity and tree, seal, component versions, and evidence files, regardless of outcome. It does not inspect lineage or apply the record's outcome failures; an empty list means these identity and integrity checks found no problems.
examples: record is for commit fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba98, not 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The promise may reject with an Error propagated from Git revision or tree access, source loading, record-store reads, or evidence file access; these failures are not converted into CheckReport problems.

errors.name: Filesystem rejection
errors.description: A bounded filesystem operation can reject with its original error/code; this is a failure category rather than an invented runtime error class.
